snippet.title: Blast Blade - Official Teaser #1
snippet.description:
Blast Blade is a fast-paced 3D Platform Fighter developed by Silent Bark Games and Quantum Peaks.

WE ARE DIFFERENT!!
The world’s only third-person platform fighter where every match is won by blasting opponents out of the arena. Playing fluidly in Unreal Engine 5 with richly hand-painted characters and immersive environments.

Knock ’em out in Full 3D! 💥
Blast Blade breaks free from traditional 2D left-to-right combat, turning the entire platform and the open air into a 360-degree battleground.

Victory isn't about raw power—it's about skill, precise timing, and fluid third-person combat. Take control of the battlefield, beat your opponents from every angle, chain together explosive aerial combos, and fight alongside your friends to dominate every inch of the arena!

🔥 Wishlist now on Steam!
👉 https://bit.ly/BlastBlade-Steam

🌐 Official Channels:
Website: https://www.blastbladegame.com
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@BlastBladeGame
Discord: https://discord.gg/anRv4nWzU
